---
title: "Research"
description: "Selected publications by John Levendis on telecommunications and economic development, dynamic panel GMM methods, and applied microeconomics."
---

My research examines IT infrastructure, market efficiency, and firm performance, with a particular focus on emerging economies. I use econometric methods including panel data models, VAR, and unit root tests.

For a complete list of publications, see my [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=z3fzlb4AAAAJ) or [ORCID profile](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9529-2998).
